entry.name: mc.phasor~
entry.description: Use the phasor~ object to generate sawtooth waves suitable for sample-accurate control and timing tasks. For smoother sounding sawtooth generation, use the bandlimited saw~ object instead. The ramp rate can be set by frequency (Hz), or as an interval using the tempo-relative Max time format syntax.

attributes.name: jitter
attributes.digest: Frequency Jitter
attributes.description: Theattributes sets the range of random frequency variation on each phase reset. The frequency deviation above and below will be 1/100th of the value oftimes the frequency. Example: if the current frequency is 440 andis 1.0,will generate random frequencies between 439.56 and 440.44 Hz.only applies when a signal is not connected to the frequency inlet and theattribute is disabled.

attributes.digest: Jitter Limit
attributes.description: Theattribute sets an absolute amount by which the frequency can vary from its set value as a result of a non-zeroattribute. Ifis reduced, the frequency may be changed gradually to bring it closer to the set value.

attributes.name: lock
attributes.digest: Frequency lock enable
attributes.description: Whenis set to 1, theis synchronized to the Max (or Max for Live) transport. When the transport is off, thewill output a frequency of zero. For accurate timing,must be enabled. Theattribute will only accept frequencies specified using notevalues.

attributes.name: phaseoffset
attributes.digest: Phase Offset
attributes.description: Theattribute sets the initial phase when audio is turned on as well as the phase assigned whenreceives themessage. Theis useful when decorrelating multiple instances within an. If theattribute has never been set or the wordis sent with no arguments, the initial phase will nor be changed when audio processing is started. When you set the phase with ain the right inlet, it is an immediate change but it only happens once. Theattribute makes it possible to set up repeatable phase relationships between multipleobjects or when using.

attributes.name: syncupdate
attributes.digest: Sync Frequency Update
attributes.description: Whenis set to 1, thefrequency is only set at the end of its cycle, when the phase jumps to 0. In this mode,will not instantly change its slope when it receives a frequency change, but will instead wait until the phase resets. This can prevent typical pitch glitches when reading from a buffer.

attributes.name: transport
attributes.digest: Transport
attributes.description: This attribute names a time. If frequency is specified using a 'relative' unit (for example: ticks, bars.beats.units, or notevalues), then the namedis used to determine the frequency based on tempo, time-signature, and other related information. The default value is the global 'internal' transport.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Whenis set to 1there is no signal input connected to the left inlet, a bang in the left inlet will force the frequency to update immediately (instead of waiting for the phase cycle to end and jump back to 0).

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: Set the frequency of the sawtooth waveform (Hz). If a signal is connected to this inlet, this message is ignored.In right inlet: Set the phase of the waveform (from 0 to 1). Signal output continues from this phase.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: Set the frequency of the sawtooth waveform (Hz). If a signal is connected to this inlet, this message is ignored.In right inlet: Set the phase of the waveform (from 0 to 1). Signal output continues from this phase.

messages.name: reset
messages.description: Themessage immediately sets the phase to the value of theattribute.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: Set frequency in HzIn right inlet: A signal connected to the right inlet can trigger a phase reset with a non-zero value. When a signal-triggered reset occurs, the phase will be set to the current value of theattribute.

outlets.description: Note the output rarely reaches 0 or 1 so that the frequency and phase will remain sample-accurate.
